title: Atitos
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He brought up firstborn animals from Babylonia to Jerusalem (Challah, end of ch. 4), according to the reading of the Arukh, entry "Atitos." And our reading is "ben Antigonus," while in the Mishnah of the Westerners (the Land of Israel) the reading is "ben Atatas."[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Arukh, Hyman’s text and the Western Mishnah give different name forms.

The consulted Mishnah Challah 4:11 reads ben Antinos. Hyman reports Antigonus in his text, Atitos in the Arukh, and ben Atatas in the Western Mishnah. Jastrow’s Atitos entry also reports Arukh/manuscript and Western/Mishnah variants; it is a separate lexicographical report, not a fresh collation of Hyman’s named witnesses. All supplied forms remain distinct.
